# Enabling Diagnostic Settings for Azure Firewall

This example enables the diagnostics settings on the Azure Firewall and sends them to an Log Analytics Workspace.

- Azure Firewall
- Log Analytics Workspace
- Virtual Network
- Firewall Policy
- Public IP

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    azapi = {
      source  = "Azure/azapi"
      version = "~> 2.12"
    }
    random = {
      source  = "hashicorp/random"
      version = "~> 3.5"
    }
  }
}

# This picks a random region from the list of regions.
resource "random_integer" "region_index" {
  max = length(local.azure_regions) - 1
  min = 0
}

# This ensures we have unique CAF compliant names for our resources.
module "naming" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-utl-naming/azure"
  version = "0.2.0"
}

# This is required for resource modules
resource "azapi_resource" "resource_group" {
  location = local.azure_regions[random_integer.region_index.result]
  name     = module.naming.resource_group.name_unique
  type     = "Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups@2024-03-01"
}

resource "azapi_resource" "virtual_network" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.virtual_network.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks@2024-05-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      addressSpace = {
        addressPrefixes = ["10.1.0.0/16"]
      }
      subnets = [
        {
          name = "AzureFirewallSubnet"
          properties = {
            addressPrefix = "10.1.0.0/26"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "public_ip" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.public_ip.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses@2024-05-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      publicIPAddressVersion   = "IPv4"
      publicIPAllocationMethod = "Static"
    }
    sku = {
      name = "Standard"
      tier = "Regional"
    }
    zones = ["1", "2", "3"]
  }
  tags = {
    deployment = "terraform"
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "firewall_policy" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.firewall_policy.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies@2024-05-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      sku = {
        tier = "Standard"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "log_analytics_workspace" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.log_analytics_workspace.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces@2023-09-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      retentionInDays = 30
      sku = {
        name = "PerGB2018"
      }
    }
  }
}

# This is the module call
module "firewall" {
  source = "../../"

  firewall_sku_name   = "AZFW_VNet"
  firewall_sku_tier   = "Standard"
  location            = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name                = module.naming.firewall.name
  resource_group_name = azapi_resource.resource_group.name
  diagnostic_settings = {
    to_law = {
      name                  = "diag"
      workspace_resource_id = azapi_resource.log_analytics_workspace.id
      log_groups            = ["allLogs"]
      metric_categories     = ["AllMetrics"]
    }
  }
  enable_telemetry   = var.enable_telemetry
  firewall_policy_id = azapi_resource.firewall_policy.id
  firewall_zones     = ["1", "2", "3"]
  ip_configurations = {
    default = {
      name                 = "ipconfig1"
      subnet_id            = "${azapi_resource.virtual_network.id}/subnets/AzureFirewallSubnet"
      public_ip_address_id = azapi_resource.public_ip.id
    }
  }
}
```
